name: Nothing Ear (3a)
notes: Codec values 1 (LHDC) and 3 are accepted and stored by the firmware but produce no A2DP endpoint on this model, so they are omitted here. Reconnect after changing the codec: the endpoint set is fixed at A2DP negotiation. The advanced per-band equaliser (0xC06C/0xC06D) and the Mimi personalised-audio group (0xC022-0xC025) do not answer on this model.
